title: Yahoo Finance Scraper
description: Provide stock or crypto ticker symbols (or search queries) to extract quotes and optional historical price data from Yahoo Finance. No login or API key required.

searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: Company or asset names to look up and resolve to ticker symbols (e.g. "apple", "bitcoin").

includeHistorical.title: Include Historical Prices
includeHistorical.description: If enabled, each quote includes a historical OHLCV time series.

historicalRange.title: Historical Range
historicalRange.description: Time range for historical data (used when 'Include Historical Prices' is on).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Yahoo Finance is generally open; enable proxies to avoid rate limits on large runs.
